author: barntables
body:
Reported Player(s): N/A
Rule Broken: Using a hacked client (NoSlowDown).
Evidence: N/A

Please note that this does not concern any one particular player.

Recently I have been playing on Nexus and have seen people sprinting while shooting a bow and/or eating. These people have all been donators and/or prestige's. When I asked them if it was some kind of perk, they said:

"It is a glitch"

If it is somehow not a hack (which I am pretty sure it is) how could this be, and isn't it bug exploiting?

This is just a heads up, you could say, as I am sick of this happening in game.

title: NoSlowDown

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
I'm not sure about the other staff but I have never heard of such 'glitch'. If it is some form of bug, then yes, it would be considered exploitation.

Otherwise feel free to use the in-game report function (or record and post in here in the Player Reports section). Thanks for your concern, we'll be sure to keep an eye out!

EDIT: I'll keep this thread open for now in case other staff want to contribute.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
This is indeed a glitch, abusing it will get the player punished for his/her actions.

Feel free to use /report in-game to report these players.

(Keep in mind this is a Minecraft glitch, not a server glitch.)
